Bug_Title: SA: Self assignment of local rather than assignment to field (SA_LOCAL_SELF_ASSIGNMENT_INSTEAD_OF_FIELD)
Bug_Explanation: The method'setData' contains a self assignment of the local variable 'data', instead of assigning the value to the instance variable 'data'. This makes the assignment useless.
Trigger_Explanation: The JUnit test case calls the'showBug' method with a test data value. The'showBug' method then calls the'setData' method with the same test data value. However, the'setData' method assigns the value to its local parameter 'data' instead of the instance variable 'data'. This causes the test to fail because the returned result is not equal to the test data value.
Bug_Trigger_Explanation: The test results show that the test passed (OK (1 test)), which means that the result was equal to the testData. This indicates that the self-assignment in the Java code did not occur as expected, and therefore the bug was not triggered.
